'''2001 Candace Hall Memorial''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament held in Broken Games in 2001. [[Charles Hickey]] won it.<ref name="dt-16075">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16075 Candace Hall Winner], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 20 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16075/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16075/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 20 May)
* '''Site:''' Broken Games
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Charles Hickey]]

The event is known from a player's DeckTech post, which gives no date or city beyond the store, Broken Games. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

== Results ==

Results below come from players' own DeckTech deck posts. Each row cites the post that gives it. A Dark or Light cell shows — until the deck page is linked.

Hickey won the Candace Hall Memorial Event at Broken Games with his Light deck, with a combined score of 4 (+51) over four games.<ref name="dt-16075" />
